dislocation.headline: Buyable-washout regime: a stress dislocation with the Fed put intact (no recession trigger, 10y breakeven 2.32% < 2.5%). Historically these mean-revert with shallower median drawdown — confirm into stabilization, don't anticipate. The gate has known misses: it printed buyable early in the 2000-02 bear and twice in 2022 within 0.02pp of this cutoff.
